messages:
maria: Quick pre-launch sweep — gentle reminder we start change window at 21:00 UTC. Need green on: release notes published, deploy-bot pin set, canary annnounced, rollback owner assigned. Will call go/no-go at 20:45.

deploy-bot: Deploy plan uploaded: https://ci.redwood.ai/runs/3489 :white_check_mark:
- canary targets: eu-west-1 / us-west-2
- model variant: gptx-4-8k-quant-v2
- reserved nodes: rdw-dedicated-03

alex: Release notes link? I want to confirm the telemetry changes and the new token-metering header.

jamie: Release notes posted here: https://docs.redwood.ai/releases/2026-03-20-launch :memo: short highlights in the top section about KV cache and batching defaults.

sam: Pin status? We need the deploy pinned to commit c7f9b2 so we can rollback to it quickly if needed.

deploy-bot: Pin applied: commit c7f9b2 -> channel=prod canary (operator=maria) :pushpin:
To unpin: `deploy-bot unpin --channel prod --commit c7f9b2`

maria: Confirming pin. sam, you are backup rollback owner; ops-runner primary. Can you both ack?

sam: Ack. I will be on-call and watching error budgets.

ops-runner: Ack. I’ll keep an eye on latency and request success ratio. If p50 > 180ms for 3 consecutive 1-min buckets or error rate > 1% for 5m, we rollback.

alex: What’s the automated rollback command? Put it in thread so oncall can execute quickly.

ops-runner: Rollback command (manual):
```
deploy-bot rollback --channel prod --to-commit c7f9b2 --reason "canary regressions"
```
Automated fallback: if health-checker reports sustained 5xx spike > 1.5x baseline for 2m, deploy-bot will trigger a soft-fail to canary.

deply-bot: (typo) Sorry! ignore previous.

deploy-bot: Correction: automated fallback threshold = 1.5x baseline 5xx for 180s -> soft-fail. Hard rollback requires human approve.

jamie: Canary announcement ready. Sending to #customers-prod-notify at 21:05 UTC. Also posting changelog to internal digest.

maria: Double-check monitors: traces, token billing, embeddings pipeline. Anyone see missing checks?

alex: Added a quick smoke script to run after canary warmup: `./scripts/smoke_check.sh --seed traffic-100`. Will post output to thread.

sam: Please remember the embeddings cache migration flag — keep it OFF during canary. Toggle only after full prod rollout.

ops-runner: Noted. Will block config change until canary passes.

maria: OK - final checklist: release notes ✅, pin ✅, rollback owners ✅, smoke script ✅, canary targets ✅, monitors ✅. Going to run the preflight 20:40. Ping here for go/no-go at 20:45. :rocket:

alex: Thanks — I’ll be by the terminal at 20:40 in case we need an emergency patch.

sam: Oncall Slack presence confirmed.

ops-runner: Infra warmup scheduled at 20:50 UTC.

deploy-bot: Preflight hooks executed at 20:40: OK. Canary deployment scheduled for 21:00 UTC.

maria: GO from me at 20:45. :thumbsup:

jamie: GO as well.

sam: GO.

ops-runner: GO. Monitoring dashboards pinned to the thread. If anything spikes, call me and run the rollback command.

deploy-bot: Canary started at 21:00 UTC. Logs: https://ci.redwood.ai/logs/3489/canary

maria: Thanks team — keep updates short and in-thread. If rollback happens, paste the command and reason here.

alex: Canary smoke: 21:03 — p50 142ms, error rate 0.12%. Passing so far.

sam: Observability: embeddings queue lag showing a 4s tail spike at 21:04, but transient. Watching.

ops-runner: If lag moves > 10s for 2m -> call rollback.

jamie: Notifying customer success about partial rollout at 21:05.

maria: Closing the loop — canary stable at 21:12. Proceeding with gradual rollout to 25% in 10m increments. :tada:
